findings.title: After a content-status change that the server applied but whose reply was lost (502/timeout), the row keeps the OLD status and the alert says the update failed
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-C/t8_misc.mjs (block 1); screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-C/shots/lost_response.png. Server GET /content/missions says hem-01 = approved; the UI row shows 'Reviewed ... Approve' with alert 'Could not update the status: Request failed (502)'.
findings.repro: Open Content review, route PUT /api/content/missions/*/status so it calls route.fetch() (server applies it) then fulfils 502, click Approve on a reviewed row.
findings.expected: Like the Learning settings page (progress.tsx update()), re-read the list after a network/5xx/unreadable reply so the row shows the real status and the message does not claim a failure that did not happen.
findings.actual: Only 409/404 trigger a re-read. For 0/5xx/invalid-JSON the row is stale until the user presses the same button again (the server treats it as a no-op and the row then catches up). Audited approval of clinical content is shown in the wrong state.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/faculty.tsx ~line 344: extend the 409/404 resync branch to every non-4xx failure (status 0, >=500, invalid_response, PayloadError).

findings.area: Student dashboard (overall / labs cleared vs Master Lab)
findings.title: Dashboard contradicts itself once the Master Lab is involved: 'Labs cleared 3' next to four CLEARED cards, and '9 of 9 - 100% of the investigation map' while the Master Lab is open (0 of 1) with the CTA 'Start the next investigation'
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-C/shots/ui_dash_Zed_Ten.png (4 lab cards CLEARED, 'Labs cleared 3', 'All investigations complete.', 7 of 7 badges) and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-C/shots/ui_dash_Zed_Nine.png (9 of 9, 100% of the investigation map, hero 'Continue your investigations', Master card 'ACTIVE 0 of 1 mission'). Numbers all match the API/DB (audit.mjs: 2025 checks, 0 mismatches), so this is wording, not data.
findings.repro: Seed/play a student to 9 standard missions (+ optionally the Master mission) and open the dashboard (script t4_ui_student.mjs, cohort.json students 'Zed Nine' and 'Zed Ten').
findings.expected: Where the counted basis (9 standard missions, 3 standard labs) differs from what the page shows (4 lab cards, a 10th mission), say so ('3 of 3 standard labs', 'Master Lab: extra') or label the percentage 'of the standard missions'. The server's definition is documented as deliberate, the missing explanation on the student page is not.
findings.actual: '100% of the investigation map' while a mission of the map is still open; 'Labs cleared 3' with four CLEARED cards. Only the faculty page carries the 'Master Lab not counted' note.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/student.tsx ~line 55-57: detail strings ('100% of the standard missions', '3 of 3 standard labs · Master Lab is a bonus') using server-provided totals.

findings.title: A namesake that differs only by an internal double space ('Alex  Martin') is not tagged with its #id, so it reads exactly like the tagged 'Alex Martin #80'
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-C/shots/d_phone_namesakes.png and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-C/shots/f_phone_many2.png (class with 'Alex Martin #80', 'alex martin #81' and an untagged 'Alex Martin'); t9_detail.mjs.
findings.repro: API: join one class with students 'Alex Martin', 'alex martin', 'Alex  Martin' (two spaces). Open Faculty and Student detail.
findings.expected: Names are compared the way the browser shows them (whitespace collapsed).
findings.actual: nameTags folds only trim + lower case; HTML collapses the double space, so one of three identical-looking rows has no discriminator.

findings.title: A 401 from the old token that lands while a guest switch is in flight AND the switch then fails leaves 'This page could not be loaded - Your guest session is no longer valid' with no automatic recovery (token already cleared)
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-C/t8_misc.mjs (block 2), screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-C/shots/failing_switch_401.png; also t2_race.mjs 'desk 401 during FAILING switch'. Retry recovers (new guest + expiry notice).
findings.repro: Click Faculty guest with /auth/demo answering 500 after 1 s; within 200 ms open Progress with that old token answering 401.
findings.expected: Failed switch + dead session should end in the recovery path or the gate with Reopen.
findings.actual: Error panel whose Retry works only because the retry itself 401s without a bearer and then starts the recovery.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/app.tsx ~line 77: remember a suppressed 401 (ref) and, if enterGuest fails, run the recovery.
